name: Chickpea Cucumber Bowl
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu, cubed and pan-toasted
¼ cup chopped mint and coriander
Dressing: 2 tsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, ½ tsp roasted cumin powder, black salt, black pepper
steps: Pan-toast the tofu in a dry non-stick pan for 5 minutes until lightly golden; cool.
Whisk the dressing in a large bowl.
Add the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion, chilli and herbs.
Toss with the dressing and tofu.
Rest for 10 minutes so the flavours mix, then serve.
note: A no-cook, high-fibre salad; the chickpeas and tofu make it a full meal.
